recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則，骨小樑之間的造血空間被稠密交織的黑色網狀纖維取代，細胞稀少且竇狀血管擴張，符合骨髓纖維化合併骨硬化（osteomyelosclerosis）。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae occupying much of the field (osteosclerosis)
Dense, diffuse meshwork of reticulin fibers with extensive intersections in the intertrabecular space
describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae with narrowed intertrabecular spaces. The remaining marrow space contains a dense, diffuse network of reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and coarse, streaming bundles, associated with dilated sinusoids and markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity. Findings correspond to high-grade reticulin fibrosis (at least MF-2 to MF-3, pending trichrome assessment) with osteosclerosis, consistent with advanced primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor produces fibrosis around cohesive epithelial nests that are keratin positive, whereas this fibrosis is diffuse with atypical megakaryocytes in PMF.
Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows paratrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption, rather than diffuse intertrabecular fibrosis with MPN megakaryocytes.
HCL causes diffuse reticulin fibrosis with a fried-egg infiltrate of CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive cells, without new bone formation.
Mastocytosis shows fibrosis and osteosclerosis around spindle mast cell aggregates that are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
